scripts.build: pnpm build-schema && pnpm build-i18n && pnpm build-web
scripts.build-web: cp schema/UnifiedItemType.json schema/UnifiedItemData.json schema/Asset.json schema/Rates.json web/src/schema
scripts.build-schema: pnpm build-testing-schema && pnpm build-ui-schema && pnpm build-backend-schema
scripts.build-ui-schema: rm -rf ui/src/Types/API/ && json2ts --cwd schema/ -i schema/ -o ui/src/Types/API/
scripts.build-backend-schema: rm -rf backend/src/types/API/ && json2ts --cwd schema/ -i schema/ -o backend/src/types/API/ && tar cf - `find ./schema -name '*.json'` | tar -C ./backend/src/types/API --strip-components 2 -xv
scripts.lint: pnpm lint-ui && pnpm lint-backend && pnpm lint-testing
scripts.fix: pnpm fix-ui && pnpm fix-backend && pnpm fix-testing && git status
scripts.prepare-test: docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate && docker exec tadex-api bin/wait-for-it.sh -t 120 -h localhost -p 7302 && cd backend && DATABASE_URL=postgres://dev:02u3QD2e3wxssfdr3sxds@localhost:7300/tadex pnpm run migrate
scripts.test: pnpm run lint && pnpm run prepare-test && cd testing && pnpm run test
scripts.preinstall: cd database && pnpm install && cd ../backend && pnpm install && cd ../ui && pnpm install && cd ../testing && pnpm install && cd ../web && pnpm install
